name: Ongeku
summary: Uthek the Wise of the Gelkis says you still have more to prove, and that for now the Gelkis will take on the Magram without your help. The earth has whispered to Uthek of draenethyst, and you are sent far away to the Swamp of Sorrows for a shard held by the lost one Ongeku.

sections.title: A Crystal from Far Away
sections.body: After Stealing Supplies, Uthek the Wise tells you that your next undertaking lies a long way off. Those who listen hear many secrets in the earth, and one Uthek has heard is of a red crystal called draenethyst, newly arrived in this land and brought from a place of flying mountains and ruling demons. A shard of it, Uthek says, will make the magic strong. The lost one Ongeku holds a shard in the Swamp of Sorrows in the Eastern Kingdoms. When you return, Uthek will look for proof that the Gelkis can still call you friend.

faq.answer: A Gelkis centaur at Gelkis Village in Desolace who says the earth whispers its secrets to those who listen.
A red crystal that Uthek calls new to our earth. He says it comes from a land of flying mountains where demons rule.
A Lost One who holds a shard of draenethyst in the central Swamp of Sorrows, in the Eastern Kingdoms.

faq.q: Why does Uthek want a draenethyst shard?
faq.answer: Uthek says a shard will make the magic strong.
Stealing Supplies, which Uthek gave you earlier.
